column1: # Copy to kits.tsv and fill in. Tab-separated; lines starting with # are ignored.
# At least TWO different kit names are required, otherwise the run reports itself
# INCOMPLETE: one kit cannot show that the result does not depend on the kit.
# kit      a label for the capture kit (any string; rows with the same label share a kit)
# sample   a sample label (used as the --coverage label)
# coverage mosdepth --quantize 0:10: output for that sample (*.quantized.bed.gz),
# target   that kit's target BED. Column 4 should name the regions (exon or gene_exonN)
# exclude  optional low-mappability / repeat BED on the same build; leave empty for none
# Placeholders only - no dataset is named here because none has been chosen and checked:
